title: AgentOps Claim Registry
description: Curated policy overlay: which claims exist, their tier, evidence, and allowed citation surfaces.

tiers.description: Tier definitions (informational — the enum is the authority).

cite_allowed.description: Surface globs where this tier may be cited without triggering citation-ceiling gate.

surfaces.description: Files where this claim marker appears (populated by regen; curated additions allowed).

owner.description: Agent or human responsible for promoting this claim.

evidence.description: Paths to evidence artifacts (docs/evidence/*, eval results, etc.).

eval_binding.description: Scenario or eval ID that can mechanically promote this claim.

notes.description: Curator notes on the claim's status or next steps.
